name: Valleyview House
accommodation: Four rooms: Coos Suite, King, Twin and Small Double
suitableFor: Couples and friends wanting a quiet countryside B&B
confirmedFeatures: En-suite rooms, free Wi-Fi, tea and coffee, suite with sitting area, Highland cows
overview: Valleyview House is a bed and breakfast at Murkle, around five minutes' drive from Thurso, with views towards Dunnet Head. It has four rooms, including a first-floor suite with a sitting area, and the owners keep Highland cows. Parking is free and secure.
surfTripFit: It is a short drive into Thurso for the beach and also handy for Dunnet Bay on smaller days.
